height: Single-source career profile snapshot, inches; cm = inches * 2.54.
positions: Season metadata positions, pipe separated; multi-position membership is preserved.
decades: Group by season START year; deduplicate people inside each decade, union positions in its seasons. 2020s ends at 2025-26.
minutes: Player-season regular-season totals, one row per player-season; transfer stints replaced by the reported total where present. Minutes are NOT time spent at each listed position.
honors: Selections/winners in the indicated season, including selected injured players; honor status is independent of games played. 1999 had no All-Star game.
missing: Blank height stays missing; exclude only from height-based calculations and disclose denominator.
source_rows: Original CSV line numbers including header; file/member names are in sources.json.
